name: boplog public build archive
description: Read-only public archive of GitHub repositories where Kevin Rajan (kvnloo) authored commits.
whenToUse: A user asks what Kevin Rajan or kvnloo has publicly built or committed to on GitHub.
A user needs exact public project fields by name, year, topic, language, or format.
A user asks for evidence-backed public contribution history represented in this archive.
constraints: Prefer exact fields from the manifest and year-partitioned JSON files.
Do not infer private repositories, funding, headcount, clients, addresses, phone numbers, or unpublished roadmaps.
Do not conflate contributor forks or canonical upstream contributions with owned repositories.
